selection.size_measure: Total proposed homes in each application, across all its phases. Counts do not imply homes are completed or currently for sale.
selection.coverage: Fifteen large residential proposals selected from non-closed City applications, using proposed home totals across each application and its phases. This is a sourced selection, not an exhaustive current citywide ranking. Report dates are shown because designs and counts can change.
selection.excluded: 24-0286-00 Gateway is Concluded in current City GIS. Georgetown West uses 2,079 homes in the September 2025 report, replacing an older 2,208 count.
selection.geometry: All selected applications have official site outlines. Models are available only where source-plan massing has been prepared and recorded in proposed-building-sources.json. An application boundary is not a building footprint.
